description.value: Hidden Chapel Winery is a small boutique winery nestled in the pines near Oliver in the South Okanagan, producing estate wines from sandy loam soils at the northern tip of the Great Basin Desert. The winery ages its wines in a unique underground cellar overlooked by the namesake hidden chapel, surrounded by beautiful gardens. Visitors can explore a range of whites, rosés, and reds — including estate-grown Cabernet Sauvignon — at the cheerful tasting room and wine shop, located only 5 km from Oliver and 3 km from the District Wine Village.
